verdicts.reason: A: a clean top-to-bottom stack with the hero circle, then GROVE, then the headline. Its flaws: the left-aligned text block clashes with the right-aligned pills and CTA, and the pills nearly touch each other and run to the right canvas edge. B: the headline is overprinted on the product image and the circle, and the circle runs off the left edge. The bottom ~40% of the canvas is empty except for the stray FREE DELIVERY badge in the corner. The pills and CTA are shrunk to tiny sizes and GROVE is minuscule, so B is unusable.
